BiblicalUsage: The word tᵉrêyn carries the sense of two. In Ezra 4:24, ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto, and it appears again in Daniel 4:29.
TheologicalSignificance: Even the plain number two, tucked into a halted temple project and a king's story, tells me God counts details I would skip over.
